description: A director of student services must decide how the district will accept and deploy a donation of musical instruments for school music programs, with input from a music teacher and the district risk manager.

shared_context.S1: A local foundation has offered the district 18 used musical instruments for student music programs.
shared_context.S2: Ms. Brooks makes the final decision about accepting the donation and approving its district handling plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft plan proposes accepting all 18 instruments, placing them in the central music storeroom, and making them available after a basic checkout entry.
shared_context.S4: The district's routine approval process includes a final check with the music teacher and risk manager before donated equipment is accepted.

PF1.text: Mr. Singh inspected all 18 instruments this morning: 14 are serviceable after ordinary cleaning, while 4 have cracked bodies or unsafe keys and should be returned to the donor rather than issued to students. He recorded the inspection on paper, but the donation spreadsheet has not yet been updated.

PF2.text: Ms. Hart confirmed with the district insurer this week that donated instruments may be used only after each instrument's serial number and condition are entered in the district asset register and the instruments are kept in a locked, access-controlled cabinet when not in use. She has not yet attached the insurer's confirmation to the approval packet.

acceptance_conditions: The district must accept exactly 14 instruments.
The four unsafe instruments must be returned to the donor.
Use must not be authorized until asset-register entry is complete.
A serialized asset-register commitment must be recorded.
A locked-storage commitment must be recorded.
The inspection finding must be cited in the decision justification.

content_checks.C5: decisions.get('serialized_registration_required', False) == True or any(c['type'] in ['serialized_asset_register', 'handling_plan_revision', 'insurer_requirement_compliance', 'documentation', 'plan_revision'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: decisions.get('locked_access_controlled_storage_required', False) == True or any(c['type'] in ['locked_storage', 'storage_requirement', 'storage', 'insurer_requirement_compliance', 'plan_revision'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The inspection changes the accepted quantity from all 18 instruments to exactly 14 and changes the unsafe-instrument disposition from accepting them to not accepting them.
The insurer's confirmation changes the handling plan by requiring asset-register entry before use, serialized registration, and locked, access-controlled storage.
